Esbjerg forenede Boldklubber is a Danish professional football club based in Esbjerg, West Jylland, that plays in the Danish 1st Division, the second tier of the Danish football league system. Founded in 1924 as a merger between Esbjerg Boldklub af 1898 and Esbjerg Amatørklub af 1911, the first team play their home games at Blue Water Arena which has been the club's home ground since its opening in 1955.
